paragraphs: KISTERS describes itself as a company of experts in environmental monitoring, data, IT and sensors. The homepage dates the company at 60 years and its local presence in the U.S. and Canada at 20 years.

Sensor products include tipping bucket rain gauges, snow sensors that measure snow water equivalent, and non-contact water radar sensors. Water software covers hydrometric data management, dam safety web visualization, and radar and raster data delivered within a web browser. The hydro pages frame that work around dams and reservoirs, called critical assets for regional, state and national water management.

A separate line of software handles load forecasting and optimization of generation and storage, sold as SaaS or enterprise software. Energy customers are described as operating and maintaining renewable energy generation assets.

quote.text: Engineering data-driven and technology-led solutions for 60 years
